answer.free_form_answer: Answer with content missing: (Evaluation section) Given that in CLIR the primary goal is to get a better ranked list of documents against a translated query, we only report Mean Average Precision (MAP).

title: A Multi-Task Architecture on Relevance-based Neural Query Translation
